report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, order, postgres, redis) and metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~98ms on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects normal latency. Handing off rather than asserting a cause.
